title: should render description as a textarea, show Save changes label and persist a multi-line description
verifies: the description field is a multiline textarea, the save button reads 'Save changes', footer/helper copy renders, and a multi-line description persists across reopen

title: should show a dependency chip on the dependent variable and not on the independent one
verifies: the dependent query-value variable shows a dependency-count chip ('1') with a 'Depends on: ...' tooltip while the independent variable shows no chip

title: should show the no-variables empty state and its CTA opens the Add Variable form
verifies: a fresh dashboard's Variables tab shows the 'no variables yet' empty state and its CTA opens the Add Variable form

title: should show panel-count badge 0 on an empty tab and 1 after adding a panel
verifies: the view-header tab panel-count badge reads 0 on an empty tab and increments to 1 after adding a panel
